# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected security vulnerabilities privately by email to
[apm.aufhauser@gmail.com](mailto:apm.aufhauser@gmail.com). Do not include
personal health information, credentials, or exploit details in a public GitHub
issue.

Include the affected URL, a concise description, reproducible steps, and the
potential impact. Reports will be reviewed as soon as practicable. Please allow
reasonable time for investigation and remediation before public disclosure.

## Scope

The supported public deployment is:

- <https://websiteapmaufhauser.vercel.app/>

Third-party services linked or embedded by the site, including Google Maps,
Vercel, Resend, Upstash, and Gmail, are governed by their respective security
programs.
